up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows with IC50 measurements for the human single-protein target identified by ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1293265 (Serine/threonine-protein phosphatase). Only include rows where the standard relation is exactly '=' and the pChEMBL value is not null. The output must contain the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from the assays table), target type (from target dictionary), target taxonomy ID (tax_id), canonical SMILES (from compound structures), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule dictionary), standard type (from activities), and pChEMBL value (from activities). Order the results first by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID. Limit the result set to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293265' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
